preconditions.description: The number of pairs is at least 2 and at most 2 * 10^5.
The number of colors is at least 2 and at most 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by a valid sequence of $n$ pairs where each pair consists of two integers between 1 and $k$, inclusive, and satisfies all the given conditions.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= b_i, g_i <= k for b_i, g_i in output_value)
invariants.description: Each color of the costumes is an integer between 1 and $k$, inclusive.

invariants.expression: all(b_i != g_i for b_i, g_i in output_value)
invariants.description: No pair consists of costumes of the same color.

invariants.expression: all(output_value[i][0] != output_value[i+1][0] and output_value[i][1] != output_value[i+1][1] for i in range(n-1))
invariants.description: For each two consecutive pairs, both man's costume colors and woman's costume colors differ.
